Experience in a field service role preferred. Experience in the principles and practices of laboratory operations preferred. Organizing work and resources efficiently to ensure smooth operations Troubleshooting issues to identify and resolve problems efficiently Demonstrates assertiveness and confidence in the face of a challenge Effective verbal, written and presentation skills. Ability to work cross-functionally allowing for better collaboration and communication when working across teams to achieve shared objectives Intermediate skill in MS Office tools to include but not limited to Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel Working Conditions and Travel Physical requirements include: remaining in a stationary position for long periods, stair/ladder climbing, wearing PPE, operating heavy machinery, and lifting/moving up to 50 lbs. Travel requirement: Typical weekday travel is defined as daily customer visits not requiring overnight travel but expect daily driving of 50% or more. Standard field service operations for customer support consists of approximately 15% of annual On-call with the expectation of overnight travel when qualified on products. Domestic travel: required up to 90% of the time Typical Regional travel (non-overnight): 50% Monday through Friday Weekend/Holiday rotational travel: up to 15% of the time The estimated wage range for this field based role in Florida is between $32.90 and $45.00 per hour. review_candidates.title: Site Technologies Analyst
review_candidates.description: Job Description Reporting to the Senior Manager , Network and Site Technologies, the Site Technologies Analyst is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and deploying site-based technology solutions across Extendicare and ParaMed locations. This role plays a key part in ensuring the reliable operation of telephony, nurse call, security, and other site technologies while partnering with internal teams, care site leaders, and external vendors to deliver consistent, standardized technology solutions across a growing portfolio of sites. This position will be based at our Head Office in Markham, Ontario. Extendicare offers a hybrid working environment. Key Responsibilities Include Provide day-to-day support and administration of site technology solutions including telephony, nurse call, security, and other operational technology platforms across Extendicare and ParaMed locations. Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and service-related issues, working closely with Service Desk, Infrastructure, Network, and vendor partners to ensure timely resolution. Act as a technical resource for site technology deployments, upgrades, relocations, and refresh initiatives across existing and newly acquired locations. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, third-party vendors, and service providers to support technology installations, maintenance activities, testing, and issue remediation. Assist with the implementation and standardization of site technology solutions, ensuring systems align with organizational standards, operational requirements, and security best practices. Support telephony services and technologies including VoIP, SIP, PRI, POTS, Direct Routing, and related telecommunications platforms. Conduct site assessments, gather technical requirements, and provide recommendations to support operational and project-based technology needs. Create and maintain technical documentation, inventories, support procedures, configuration records, and deployment plans. Monitor the performance and reliability of site technology environments, proactively identifying risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement. Partner with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives, infrastructure projects, and technology modernization efforts across the organization. Participate in project planning, testing, implementation, and post-deployment support activities, while developing increased ownership of project deliverables over time. Provide on-site support and travel to care and operational locations as required to support deployments, troubleshooting, and business continuity needs. Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices, contributing recommendations that improve service delivery, efficiency, and user experience. Complete other duties as assigned. What We’re Looking For Postsecondary education in Information Technology, Computer Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. 1-3 years of experience in IT infrastructure, telephony, site technologies, or IT operations support. Experience supporting VoIP and telephony platforms, with working knowledge of technologies such as SIP, PRI, POTS, and Direct Routing. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and infrastructure troubleshooting. Excellent communication and customer service skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Experience working with vendors, service providers, and cross-functional business partners. Exposure to healthcare, long-term care, nurse call systems, or enterprise technology environments is considered an asset. Valid driver's licence and reliable vehicle with the ability to travel to sites as required. We value each employee, encourage equal opportunity for growth and recognize achievement. As a valued member of our team, you can expect: Continuous mentorship, support for life-long learning and growth opportunities. Opportunities for advancement and career growth within the organization. A rewarding and meaningful work experience where you can enrich your life and the lives of others through your work. Employee Family Assistance Program. Robust benefits package.
